jobs.title: Supply Chain Data Product Manager (m/f)
jobs.description:
**Supply Chain Data Product Manager, 2nd shift (m/f)**

**About the Role**

The **Supply Chain Data Product Manager** is accountable for the definition, prioritization, championing, and, most importantly, delivery of trusted, high-value Supply Chain data products that enable end-to-end visibility, operational agility, cost optimization, and service excellence across McCormick’s global supply network.

This role operates at the intersection of Supply Chain, Data & Analytics, and Technology — working in close partnership with Transformation & Technology (including Data & Analytics, Data Governance, Information Security, and Technology teams) and GBS (including Automation and Data Science & Engineering teams). The Supply Chain Data Product Manager connects people, platforms, and processes to establish a trusted, intelligent, and connected Supply Chain data foundation that supports demand planning, supply planning, manufacturing, quality, procurement, logistics, inventory management, customer service, and network optimization.

This position requires strong business acumen in core Supply Chain processes (including demand-to-supply, plan-to-produce, source-to-pay, make-to-deliver, and inventory-to-cash), data fluency, product management discipline, and the ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders in a global environment. The Supply Chain Data Product Manager plays a critical role in advancing a data-driven Supply Chain organization, strengthening data integrity and governance, and enabling timely, accurate, and insight-driven decisions that improve service levels, reduce costs, mitigate risk, and drive resilient, profitable growth.

**This role is scheduled for the 2nd shift, starting between 12:00 and 14:00 CET/CEST (Polish local time) and it’s fully remote.**

**Key Responsibilities**

- Define and execute the Supply Chain data product strategy aligned with functional and enterprise priorities.
- Own the end‑to‑end lifecycle of Supply Chain data products using Agile methodologies.
- Translate operational requirements into clear user stories and manage the product backlog.
- Partner with Data Engineering teams to deliver high‑quality, secure, and accessible data products.
- Ensure alignment with operational KPIs and enterprise data governance standards.
- Embed data quality, lineage, metadata, compliance, and traceability requirements into product design.
- Monitor adoption, performance, and business impact, driving continuous improvement.
- Promote responsible data usage and strengthen data culture across the Supply Chain organization.

## Candidate Profile

- Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business Analytics, Supply Chain, or related field.
- Experience in data product management, data strategy, or governance within a complex organization.
- Strong understanding of end‑to‑end Supply Chain processes and operational KPIs.
- Knowledge of data architecture, governance, metadata management, and modern data product concepts.
- Experience working in Agile, cross‑functional environments.
- Strong commercial and operational acumen with ability to translate data into business value.
- Excellent stakeholder management, influencing, and communication skills.
- Strong analytical mindset, data literacy, and ownership orientation.

#LI-DNI

McCormick & Company is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, colour, religion, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Supply Chain Manager
jobs.description:
Hungry for challenges? Join a group with innovation at its heart and contribute to the automotive revolution!

OPmobility is a world-leading provider of innovative solutions for a unique, safer and more sustainable mobility experience. Innovation-driven since its creation, the Group develops and produces intelligent exterior systems, customized complex modules, lighting systems, clean energy systems and electrification solutions for all mobility companies. With a €11.4 billion economic revenue in 2023, a global network of 152 plants and 40 R&D centers, OPmobility relies on its 40,300 employees to meet the challenges of transforming mobility.

Our ambition? Provide automakers with cutting-edge equipment and solutions to develop tomorrow’s clean and connected car.

The role of **Supply Chain Manager** is based in our Exterior & Lighting Business Group in **Lozorno, Slovakia**.

**Responsibilities:**

- Ensure high-performance end-to-end supply chain operations with focus on OTIF deliveries, cost efficiency, and optimal inventory levels
- Manage and optimize supply chain flows (upstream, internal, downstream – SCOOP) to meet customer and business requirementsLead and develop the supply chain team, ensuring clear structure, accountability, and performance management
- Drive KPI performance across logistics and implement effective action plans to achieve targets
- Build, manage, and control the logistics budget (transport, handling, labor, warehousing, overheads)
- Ensure availability of resources (short-, mid-, long-term) for both serial production and service parts
- Strengthen relationships with key customers and stakeholders, ensuring high service level and effective communication
- Lead continuous improvement initiatives based on lean principles and group standards
- Ensure alignment with OPmobility standards, processes, and corporate guidelines
- Support and promote a strong safety culture and ensure compliance with safety policies

**Requirements:**

- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Engineering, Economics or related field
- Strong leadership experience managing large teams in a complex environment (min. 5 years)
- Background in automotive industry is very welcome
- Excellent stakeholder management and relationship-building skills, knowledge of VW Group is highly preferred
- Proven ability to stabilize, structure, and drive team performance
- Results-driven mindset with focus on KPIs, efficiency, and execution
- Ability to operate within a corporate environment with defined standards and processes
- Fluent in Slovak/Czech and English on at lease Upper-Intermediate level

**We offer:**

- Company car for business and private use
- Career development - opportunities to grow within division or group level
- Contribution to third pillar (pension saving)
- Professional training
- Social events, sport activities
- Referral bonus, improvement idea reward, working anniversary bonus
- Contributions from Social fund, contribution to life events (wedding, birth of the child)
- Maximum pocket money for business trips abroad
- Meals in canteen for 1.00€
- Yearly salary review based on performance
- Possibility to work from home
- Flexible working hours
- Additional relax day based on seniority

As a responsible company, OPmobility pays particular attention to diversity and equality within its teams and the Group commits to treat all job applications equally.

jobs.title: Supply Chain Manager
jobs.description:
Blueland is reimagining everyday cleaning essentials with safe, products that are free from single-use plastic and eliminate the need to choose between what’s safe for your family, good for the planet, and proven to work. With 45 patents granted & 39 patents pending worldwide, Blueland’s innovative products have diverted over 1 billion single-use plastic bottles from landfills and oceans and 7.5 million pounds of CO2 from the atmosphere since 2019. While traditional cleaners are packaged in plastic and may contain up to 95% water, all Blueland products utilize tablet or powder formats, designed to be used directly or mixed with household tap water, and come in compostable or recyclable packaging. From the kitchen sink to the laundry room, we create products families can trust and afford to use over and over (and over) again. Available on and nationwide at Target, Costco, Whole Foods and select local retailers.

In a world where half of the planet’s carbon emissions come from just 36 companies, we believe that business should be a force for good and that mission and profit are not mutually exclusive—in fact, we’re proof of it. We’re committed to holding ourselves to the highest parental and environmental standards—which includes ongoing and unbiased certifications from trusted third-party organizations like Cradle to Cradle, EPA Safer Choice, USDA BioPreferred, Leaping Bunny, and EWG Verified. We’re also a Certified Climate Neutral business and certified B Corp “Best for the World.”

Blueland was featured on the Season 11 premiere of Shark Tank and successfully secured an investment. We’re also well-funded by top tier venture capital firms as well as notable investors including Gwyneth Paltrow, Justin Timberlake and founders of Sweetgreen, Thrive Market, Honest Company, Rent the Runway, and Bonobos. Our products have been featured across top tier outlets including the *New York Times*, *Fast Company*, *TechCrunch*, *VOGUE*, *Wall Street Journal*, *Inc.*, and more.

### About the Role

We are seeking an analytical, detail-oriented, and highly collaborative Supply Chain Manager to play a key role in supporting Blueland’s growing Marketplace business, with a significant focus on Amazon. This role will be responsible for ensuring we have the right inventory, in the right place, at the right time to support Marketplace demand while balancing service levels, inventory health, and working capital.

The Supply Chain Manager will own supply and inventory planning for the Marketplace channel, translating demand forecasts into actionable production, purchasing, and inventory deployment plans. This person will report to the Director of Supply Chain and work closely with our Marketplace team, contract manufacturers, packaging suppliers, and broader Operations team to proactively identify supply risks and ensure inventory is available to support both base business and key promotional events.

A critical component of this role will be leveraging deep Amazon experience to manage the unique planning requirements of the channel, including inventory positioning, replenishment, promotional planning, and maintaining healthy inventory levels across Amazon’s network.

### Responsibilities

- Own supply and inventory planning for Blueland’s Marketplace channel, primarily Amazon, ensuring inventory is positioned appropriately to support sales, promotions, and growth.
- Translate demand forecasts into monthly and weekly production, purchasing, and inventory deployment plans.
- Develop manufacturing plans with contract manufacturers, taking into consideration demand requirements, production capacity, lead times, MOQs, material and availability.
- Partner closely with the Marketplace team to incorporate Amazon-specific requirements, promotional events, Prime Day, seasonal peaks, launches, and other demand drivers into supply plans.
- Monitor Amazon inventory levels, weeks of supply, inbound inventory, sell-through, and replenishment needs to proactively identify potential out-of-stocks or excess inventory.
- Develop inventory allocation and replenishment strategies across Amazon and Blueland’s warehouse network to maintain appropriate service levels while balancing working capital objectives.
- Manage production priorities and communicate forecasts, purchase requirements, and changing business needs to contract manufacturing partners.
- Partner with packaging suppliers to forecast material requirements, place or coordinate purchase orders, and ensure packaging availability supports manufacturing plans.
- Monitor raw material, packaging, work-in-process, and finished goods availability to identify potential constraints before they impact production or customer availability.
- Manage PO issuance and track inbound materials and finished goods, proactively escalating and mitigating delays.
- Partner cross-functionally with Demand Planning, Marketplace, Finance, Logistics, and Operations teams as part of the Sales & Operations Planning process.
- Support new product launches, transitions, promotions, and discontinuations by developing supply plans and identifying inventory risks and mitigation strategies.
- Analyze forecast changes, inventory trends, production performance, and supplier constraints to recommend adjustments to the supply plan.
- Maintain accurate planning parameters, item data, lead times, MOQs, and other supply planning inputs within Blueland’s systems.
- Drive continuous improvement across supply planning processes, tools, reporting, and supplier collaboration.
- Coordinate with co-packing vendors on build needs for pre-kitted marketplace inventory, sharing monthly priorities and forecasts while monitoring component inventory levels.

### Qualifications

- 5+ years of direct Amazon supply chain, inventory planning, or replenishment experience, with a strong understanding of the operational requirements of the Amazon channel.
- 5+ years of Supply Chain, Supply Planning, Inventory Planning, or related experience, ideally within CPG or a fast-growing omnichannel consumer brand.
- Experience translating demand forecasts into production and inventory plans.
- Experience working directly with contract manufacturers and/or external manufacturing partners to manage production schedules, capacity, and inventory requirements.
- Experience planning packaging or raw material requirements and working with external suppliers.
- Strong understanding of inventory management concepts, including safety stock, lead times, service levels, inventory turns, and weeks/days of supply.
- Proven ability to identify supply and inventory risks and develop mitigation plans.
- Highly analytical, detail-oriented, and organized with the ability to manage large amounts of data while maintaining accuracy.
- Comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment and adjusting plans as demand, production capacity, and business priorities change.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to translate complex planning information into clear recommendations and actions.
- Demonstrated ability to build strong relationships and hold external partners accountable to commitments.
- Advanced proficiency with Google Sheets and Excel required.
- Experience with NetSuite and supply/demand planning systems preferred.

### Salary

The salary range for this position is $110,000-115,000 per year.

We prioritize our planet and our people. In addition to salary compensation, we offer various other benefits to ensure our team members can be their best self, both in and outside of work. Benefits for full time roles include: health benefits, stock options, generous paid time off, paid holidays, paid civic engagement days, paid parental leave, 401k (employee contribution), professional development stipends, remote work reimbursements, various discounts to like-minded companies and more.

At Blueland we believe in order to build a better future and planet, we must advocate for diversity, equity and inclusion. We are proud to have assembled a diverse team and strongly encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every qualification.

View our California Personnel and Applicant Privacy Notice.

As a Supply Chain Project Manager, you will be responsible for:

- Maintaining the procurement relationship with server vendors, providing feedback for vendor scorecards and participating in quarterly business reviews.
- Participating in cross-functional meetings to understand strategies and aligning procurement decisions with short-term and long-term objectives.
- Collaborating with Engineering, Design, Program Management, and Planning to integrate new products and technologies while managing roadmap risk and outdated inventory.
- Addressing material shortages and unexpected conditions while collaborating with business groups to understand component roles and impacts of delays.
- Monitoring pending deployments and suggesting inter-warehouse transfers, project sequencing, and equipment substitutions to optimize timeliness and overall deployment costs.
- Demonstrating urgency in researching, tracking, and resolving supply issues efficiently by collaborating with vendors for timely, cost-effective solutions.

**Do what you love**

To be successful in this role you will:

- Have 5+ years of experience in forecasting/procurement and a Bachelor's Degree or its equivalent.
- Have experience utilizing tools like Oracle, Siebel, Tableau, Anaplan, and SQL commonly employed at Akamai for various operational tasks.
- Show Project and Vendor Management experience
- Demonstrate exceptional analytical abilities in both financial and operational contexts.
- Perform detailed tasks independently with precision and accuracy, ensuring exceptional outcomes in all responsibilities undertaken.
- Demonstrate exceptional interpersonal, negotiation, and intercultural communication abilities in both written and verbal formats effectively and professionally
